# Bull Bear Power

*High and low against an EMA: bull minus bear pressure.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Bull Bear Power** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `13` |
| Bull color | color | `"#089981"` |
| Bear color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/bbpower.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Bull Bear Power", shortTitle: "BBPower", overlay: false });
const length = input.int("Length", 13, { min: 1 });
const e = ta.ema(candle.close, length);
plot(ta.calc([candle.high, candle.low, e], (h, l, m) => h - m + (l - m)), { title: "BBPower", style: "columns",
  colorUp: input.color("Bull color", "#089981", { group: "Style" }), colorDown: input.color("Bear color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" }) });
```
